sections.label: Manpower-lean economy transition
sections.summary: Sustaining a nation of opportunities requires transiting from a manpower-led to a manpower-lean economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: To sustain a nation of opportunities, we need to transit from a manpower-led to a manpower-lean economy.

sections.label: Strengthening Singaporean Core workforce
sections.summary: Strengthening the Singaporean Core requires faster economic restructuring, more higher quality jobs, and less reliance on low-skilled foreign manpower.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: To strengthen the Singaporean Core in the workforce, we need to speed up our economic restructuring efforts and create more higher quality jobs to which Singaporeans aspire.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: Companies need to embrace productivity and innovation and reduce reliance on low-skilled foreign manpower.

sections.label: Protection, Progression and Pride
sections.summary: The three Ps will be pursued by enhancing the Employment Act, extending the Industrial Relations Act, and raising the re-employment age to 67 by 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We will seek to achieve this through the three Ps – Protection, Progression and Pride.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We have enhanced the Employment Act to protect more workers and extended the Industrial Relations Act to cover more Professionals, Managers and Executives (PMEs).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We will raise the re-employment age from 65 to 67 by 2017.

sections.label: Sectoral Manpower Plans
sections.summary: Tripartite partners are developing Sectoral Manpower Plans to create diverse career pathways for Singaporeans while meeting industry manpower needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: The tripartite partners are developing Sectoral Manpower Plans to help create diverse career pathways for Singaporeans to fulfil their aspirations, while meeting the manpower needs of industry.

sections.label: CPF retirement peace of mind
sections.summary: Greater peace of mind in retirement will be pursued by enhancing the flexibility and adequacy of the CPF system while ensuring long-term sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We want Singaporeans to have greater peace of mind in retirement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: We will continue to enhance the flexibility and adequacy of the CPF system while ensuring its long-term sustainability.

sections.label: Silver Support Scheme
sections.summary: The Silver Support Scheme will provide quarterly cash supplements for elderly Singaporeans with lesser means in retirement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: For elderly Singaporeans who have lesser means in their retirement years, we will implement the Silver Support Scheme to provide quarterly cash supplements.
